_doc: THREE different films, not three titles on one film: each has its own world, device and form. Sketch five ideas first, keep the three that differ most, make one the bold one. Devices: a moment in someone's day; a character does the work; the feature as the hook; the result first; one object across apps; life before and after; type carries the argument; a number lands; a question with the input; the object is the explanation. Forms: one continuous take; object-to-object chain; an endless zoom; a flight through one world; cut on the beat; match cuts; split screen to one; one frame that rebuilds.
